categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Doright Energy-saving Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the design, research and development, manufacturing, inspection, sales, and service of energy-saving and environmental protection equipment. Its main product lines include energy-saving heat exchange equipment (such as air preheaters, waste heat boilers, and dryers), powder and other environmental protection equipment (including wet granulators and low nitrogen burners), and customized special equipment. The company serves industries such as coal chemical, petrochemical, metallurgy, energy, and solid waste treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-temperature gas-to-gas heat exchange, gas-liquid waste heat recovery, steam soot blowing, gas-solid heat exchange drying, powder processing, and specialized equipment manufacturing. It holds multiple patents and certifications (ASME, NBBI, PED, ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001) and has developed proprietary technologies such as high-gradient electromagnetic separators and high-temperature air preheaters. Manufacturing involves complex processes with integrated design, procurement, production, and quality control, supported by digital management systems like MOM.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily from the coal chemical and petrochemical industries, with significant applications in metallurgy, energy, solid waste treatment, and emerging sectors like hydrogen energy and tire pyrolysis. Major domestic clients include leading chemical companies, while international customers span over 30 countries including Italy, Turkey, Brazil, India, Thailand, and others. The company also serves global industry leaders such as Cabot Group, Borouge, Oerlikon, General Electric, Mitsubishi, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Qingdao, Shandong Province. It has a strong international presence with exports accounting for approximately 59% of revenue, covering Asia, Europe, the Americas, Oceania, and Africa. Key overseas markets include Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with strategic focus on expanding in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao Doright operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized energy-saving and environmental protection equipment. It designs and produces core equipment used by downstream industrial customers in chemical, energy, and metallurgical processes, providing integrated solutions for heat recovery and emission reduction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in energy-saving and environmental protection technologies aligned with China's 'dual carbon' strategy. R&D priorities include high-temperature heat exchange, waste heat recovery, hydrogen energy storage and transport, solid waste and sludge treatment, and advanced carbon material processing. It invests in building a modern R&D center, expanding patent portfolios, and collaborating with universities and research institutes to enhance technological leadership and product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized and standard energy-saving equipment, powder and environmental protection equipment, and special custom equipment. The company adopts a 'sales-driven production' model with pricing based on cost plus profit margin and competitive negotiation. It also earns revenue from equipment parts sales and maintenance services. Export sales constitute a significant portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While no specific competitors are publicly listed, the company positions itself in the first tier within the energy-saving and environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry in China. It holds competitive advantages in technology, manufacturing capabilities, certifications, and international market penetration. Its brand is recognized domestically and internationally, supported by multiple industry awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 509 million, a 64.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 96.7 million, up 150.15%. The company has shown strong growth momentum with expanding domestic and international sales, increased R&D investment, and improved profitability. Total assets reached over RMB 1.12 billion with steady growth in equity and operational cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao Doright differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive product lines tailored to high-temperature and complex industrial processes, and strong customization capabilities. Its products enable efficient energy recovery, emission reduction, and cost savings for customers in high-energy-consumption industries. The company’s certifications and international standards compliance enhance its credibility and competitiveness globally. Additionally, its integrated service model and rapid response capabilities provide superior customer value.
